content.rendered:
Hello Families!

Last night’s turn out for Math Night was incredible! Thank you for taking time out of your busy evenings to join us and have fun with your student(s)! A huge thank you to PAC for their support, as always. They are a big reason the night ran so smoothly. 

We’ve had so many parent volunteers this week in our building – whether it be for Math Night, Artist in Residence, BizTown interviews, classroom support, etc. We appreciate your time and investment in our school!

Please click HERE for this weeks Update.

Enjoy the sunshine!
